instruction: Cinematic medium shot of a contemporary dance performance in a dark studio. On the left, the woman in the yellow shirt (R2) stands facing forward with both arms raised high and a serious expression. In the center, the man in the brown shirt (R3) leans forward in profile, his right arm reaching upward. On the right, the woman in the yellow shirt (R4) tilts her head up with her arms raised. In the background, several other dancers' arms reach upward. Soft overhead lighting highlights the warm yellow and brown shirts against the dark backdrop.
